verdict.rationale: Gemini's docs show robust support for generating insights from user data: uploading documents/spreadsheets/photos/videos for 'answers, summaries, and insights' (gemini-docs-25), Notebooks for organizing and querying sources (gemini-docs-11, gemini-docs-24, gemini-docs-29), Deep Research for in-depth analysis (gemini-docs-7), and Connected Apps that summarize Gmail and productivity data (gemini-docs-30). Independent hands-on reports corroborate real usage: navigating large codebases effortlessly (gemini-comm-13), replacing an OCR vendor for document ingestion with strong accuracy (gemini-comm-17), and NotebookLM being 'really powerful for comprehending large corpuses' (gemini-comm-19), though one report notes weaker accuracy on visual bounding-box tasks (gemini-comm-18). missing for 10: broader independent benchmarking specifically on insight-generation quality across data types, and resolution of the noted accuracy gaps in some visual tasks.
